meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.product: Indices of REER and NEER, annual (DBIE report 381)
meta.revisionPolicy: The latest months are provisional; the base year changes every few years (one bundle per base, never joined).
meta.coverage: The rupee against a broad basket of currencies, fiscal-year averages, 2004-05 = 100
meta.note: RBI DBIE, annual averages as RBI publishes them, base 2004-05 = 100; fiscal years plotted at April of the first year. RBI's own annual figures, kept as published; a separate ruler from every other base.
